name: PJM 进度管理指标模板
description: 项目进度管理域指标模板，涵盖节点完成率、超期率、里程碑完成率及健康度评分，基于进度信息汇总表(ods_project_subject_domain)

indicatorBlueprints.name: 项目本周期节点总数
indicatorBlueprints.definition: plan_date 在统计区间内的节点总数

indicatorBlueprints.name: 节点按时完成数
indicatorBlueprints.definition: plan_date 在统计区间内且完成情况为按时完成的节点数
indicatorBlueprints.staticFilter: plan_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND completion_status = '按时完成'

indicatorBlueprints.name: 节点按时完成率
indicatorBlueprints.definition: 节点按时完成数 / 项目本周期节点已到时间节点总数 × 100%
indicatorBlueprints.numeratorExpression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plan_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND completion_status = '按时完成')
indicatorBlueprints.denominatorExpression: NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plan_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND completion_status != '正常待完成'), 0)

indicatorBlueprints.name: 节点超期率（未完成）
indicatorBlueprints.definition: (超期未完成未变更+超期未完成已变更) / 已到时间节点总数
indicatorBlueprints.numeratorExpression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plan_date <= :endDate AND completion_status IN ('超期未完成未变更','超期未完成已变更') AND node_type != '一般节点')
indicatorBlueprints.denominatorExpression: NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plan_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND completion_status != '正常待完成'), 0)

indicatorBlueprints.name: 里程碑节点按时完成率
indicatorBlueprints.definition: 里程碑节点按时完成数 / 里程碑节点总数
indicatorBlueprints.numeratorExpression: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plan_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND node_type='里程碑' AND completion_status='按时完成')
indicatorBlueprints.denominatorExpression: NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE plan_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate AND node_type='里程碑'), 0)

indicatorBlueprints.name: 进度健康度评分
indicatorBlueprints.definition: 节点按时完成率×0.4 + 里程碑完成率×0.3 + (100-不正常率)×0.3
